comment.text: A short label or value in billing and usage information indicating the cost per gigabyte of storage, where {{price}} represents the numerical amount.

usage.context:
case ADMIN:
 case MANAGER:
 return t("Common:SpendRatePerAdmin", { price });
 case DISK_STORAGE:
 case STORAGE_ENUM:
 return t("Common:SpendRatePerGB", { price });
 case DOCS_CONNECT:
 case DOCS_CONNECT_SERVICE:
 case DOCS_CONNECT_DEVPACK_SERVICE:
 return t("Common:SpendRatePerUser", { price });
 default:
